question: Pātai: can you provide the explicit jump operators/rates and residual fault footprints for the proposed spacetime proof, or the existing source defining them, together with the resummed creation-event estimate? The latest derivation assigns p+e^(−β) to each jump, but neutral hopping and energy-lowering jumps can occur at order-one rates. What must be shown is that, after summing those motions, every bad witness requires enough independently rare creation/fault events to give the claimed suppression. I have separately proved the initial thermal-plus-fault syndrome sparsity bound, so an initial-density assumption is no longer the missing step. The unresolved part is its evolution over the holding interval.
